speaker: UNKNOWN
title: "Unfamiliar Subcontinent conditions" - Mitchell Marsh Post Match Interview | BAN vs AUS, 1st T20
quote_text:
Australia has been spun out of the first T20 International against Bangladesh in Dhaka.

In unfamiliar conditions on a subcontinent wicket, Australia bowled the hosts out cheaply but lost three early wickets to spin and never recovered.

Mitch Marsh played an almost lone had with the bat, making 45, as Australia struggled to come to terms with a low and slow Sher-e Bangla Nationals Stadium wicket.

Australia strangled the hosts early with frugal bowling and strong fielding. As he did in the West Indies Josh Hazlewood led the charge, followed by Mitchell Starc and spinners Adam Zampa and Ashton Agar.

The second match will be played at the same venue on Aug 4

#BANvAUS
